The PIN protects the app on this phone. If you forget it, the only recovery is restoring an encrypted backup.

This phone can no longer unlock the key that protects your records (this can happen after a security update or a change to the phone\'s lock settings). Try again first. If it keeps failing, you can start over and restore your latest backup file.
Start over and restore a backup

The records that cannot be opened stay on this phone, untouched, in case they can be recovered later. The app restarts with no records. Then open More, Backup & restore, and restore your latest backup file. Anything recorded after that backup is not in it.

If the app ever closes because of an error, a short report is kept on this phone. It contains only error types and code locations: no amounts, names or other records. Nothing is sent anywhere; you can save the reports and share them yourself.

resources.string: Your records exist only on this phone. If the phone is lost or reset, only a backup file can bring them back.
A backup is one file with all your records, encrypted with a passphrase you choose. You decide where it is saved, for example a memory card or a computer. The app never sends it anywhere.
No backup has been made on this phone yet.
Nobody can open the file without this passphrase, including the app. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered or reset.

Do not repeat a single character.

Restoring replaces all records on this phone with the ones in the file. The file is checked completely first; if anything is wrong, nothing changes. A copy of the current records is kept on the phone.
